scoring_justification: T1 recompute: checker recomputes Young's modulus from the agent's submitted N, condition, temperature using the paper's analytical formulas (Eq.12, Eq.16) and provided constants (a, kb, ktheta, delta, a(T) table) with anharmonic scaling, and compares with the submitted E_GPa.

hidden_assets.purpose: All physical constants and the a(T) table are inlined in grading_spec_json; no external files are needed. These are extracted from the paper's description and references.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper 'Young's modulus of silicon nanoplates at finite temperature', Applied Surface Science 255 (2008) 1543-1547. Keating force constants from Ref.[22]; lattice parameter a at 0 K from paper; delta from Ref.[26]; a(T) table approximated from Fig.3 / quasiharmonic model of Tang & Aluru (2006).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Constants copied from instruction.md and paper text; a(T) table uses values consistent with the paper's Fig.3 (0 K: 0.135775 nm, 100 K: 0.135830 nm, 500 K: 0.136200 nm, 1000 K: 0.136800 nm).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the same as those used in the paper's own semi-continuum calculations and provided publicly in the task instruction; no synthetic data.

outputs.description: Young's modulus of Si(001) nanoplate for given thickness N, surface condition, and temperature, computed analytically from the semi-continuum Keating model.

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes the expected E_GPa values using the same closed-form expressions and provided constants, comparing with tolerance ±1e-2 GPa.

steps.description: For every required combination of (N, condition, temperature_K), recompute the expected Young's modulus and compare with the submitted E_GPa value within absolute tolerance.
